# Plivex

> Plivex is a web-based billing and business management platform intended for Indian small businesses.

## Main website
- https://plivex.in/

## Public information
- About: https://plivex.in/about
- Pricing: https://plivex.in/pricing

- Terms of service: https://plivex.in/terms-of-service
- Cancellation and refund policy: https://plivex.in/cancellation-and-refund

## Product overview
Plivex supports business workflows such as invoices, quotations, client management, expense tracking, stock tracking and team roles. Refer to the website for current availability, pricing, trial conditions and product details.
